title: entitopia index-mappings envelope
description: Envelope only. Everything under `mappings` is Elasticsearch's own mapping DSL — owned elsewhere, moving independently, and already rejected loudly by the cluster, which this repo made fatal. A schema over its interior would go stale, start rejecting valid config, and teach operators to distrust the validator. Whether the mapped fields actually match the data is a question no schema can answer; that is what the validate phase's live-cluster tier is for.

index.description: Must name the same index as this step's index-config.
